'''External Communications''', known also as '''ExComm''', was a division of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. It was used to manage the equipment that relayed emergency or high priority messages between the various bureaus of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]], and the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] that required fast and immediate delivery.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
